Prior to the 2014 BlackWidow editions, Razer used Cherry MX switches. According to some Razer representatives, the main motivation behind developing a new switch was that they expected that Cherry would have problems meeting future demand for Cherry MX switches.
Both monochrome LED and RGB LED versions exist. The "Chroma" RGB versions support full-colour backlighting through the use of special RGB LEDs with all four legs inline across the switch, and a wide slit in the switch in place of the regular circular LED recess.
